mapper.sql: and (${v}.reference_asset_id is null or exists(select 1 from p_file rf where rf.id=${v}.reference_asset_id and rf.purpose='VOICE_SAMPLE' and rf.status='AVAILABLE')) and (${v}.fallback_voice_version_id is null or exists(select 1 from p_voice_version fv join p_voice fvoice on fvoice.id=fv.voice_id join p_official_service fs on fs.id=fv.official_service_id where fv.id=${v}.fallback_voice_version_id and fvoice.status in ('PUBLISHED','UNLISTED') and fv.service_type='OFFICIAL' and fs.capability='TTS' and fs.status='ACTIVE' and (fv.reference_asset_id is null or exists(select 1 from p_file fr where fr.id=fv.reference_asset_id and fr.purpose='VOICE_SAMPLE' and fr.status='AVAILABLE'))))
mapper.select: select execution_binding from p_voice_version where id=#{id}

select cast(s.id as char),s.name,s.provider_code,s.model_id,s.status,s.endpoint,s.parameters,(select c.status from p_call_record c where c.fact_kind='ATTEMPT' and c.voice_service_id=s.id order by c.updated_at desc,c.id desc limit 1) from p_official_service s where s.capability='TTS' order by s.id desc limit 100

select count(*) from p_voice_version v join p_voice voice on voice.id=v.voice_id join p_official_service s on s.id=v.official_service_id where v.id=#{id} and v.service_type='OFFICIAL' and voice.visibility='OFFICIAL' and s.status='ACTIVE' and voice.status not in ('DISABLED','DELETING','DELETED') and voice.status='PUBLISHED' and voice.current_version_id=v.id
mapper.update: update p_voice_version set provider_type=#{provider},execution_binding=cast(#{binding} as json), fallback_voice_version_id=#{fallback},reference_asset_id=#{reference},sample_file_id=#{reference} where id=#{id} and execution_binding is null
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_file where id=#{id} and account_id=#{account} and purpose='VOICE_SAMPLE' and status='AVAILABLE'
select cast(id as char) id,original_name name from p_file where account_id=#{account} and purpose='VOICE_SAMPLE' and status='AVAILABLE' order by id desc limit 100
